new_tests.name: remote_build::tests::worker_demand_production_never_infers_inventory_from_presence_or_concurrency
new_tests.scenario: Production admission registers a present worker at concurrency 1 and TEST_WORKER_CONCURRENCY, each without quantified inventory, and is required to retain the exact missing-inventory blocker and admitted demand quantities.
new_tests.required_outcomes: Neither case may create a job, resource reservation/lease, workspace lease or live output claim. The production-created current worker must remain registered with its requested concurrency and absent inventory.

new_tests.name: remote_build::tests::worker_demand_production_does_not_reuse_withdrawn_inventory_or_completed_history
new_tests.scenario: Ordinary quantified admission first creates a real coordinator job and lease. Existing attempt report helpers complete that job and release its lease. A distinct action then enters production admission with current registration omitting the formerly known inventory while completed history remains recorded.
new_tests.required_outcomes: Current inventory must be absent, exact missing-inventory blocker retained, prior completed job/claims unchanged, no new job or resource/workspace lease, and exactly one demand restating the new request rather than historical capacity.

new_tests.name: remote_build::tests::worker_demand_unrelated_fact_preserves_placement_order_and_resource_reservations
new_tests.scenario: Register two actually eligible quantified workers. Clone that admitted state, then derive an unrelated unmet demand through real admission using CPU need exceeding either inventory and a distinct request identity. Admit the same two full-inventory jobs into each state, then attempt an overflow job.
new_tests.required_outcomes: Creating demand must create no job/resource/workspace lease/output claim. Actual admission decisions must match in both states, select a-worker then b-worker, and leave identical jobs, live output claims and resource/workspace reservation maps after each dispatch. Once both workers are fully reserved, overflow must return the same resource-cpu-unavailable rejection without changing jobs/reservations, while unrelated demand remains live.
